Delhi RMNCH+A Performance Trend Dashboard

HMIS facility-reported data, FY 2021-22 to 2026-27 (Apr–Oct YTD). Click a card, chart point or bar to focus a year or domain.
Reading notes
  • All figures are summed from facility HMIS reports (Total rows only; public and private units that reported). They are service-delivery counts, not population estimates, and are affected by changes in reporting units each year.
  • Mortality “rates” are facility-reported proxies: MMR = facility maternal deaths per 1 lakh live births; NNMR/IMR/U5MR = reported neonatal, infant (neonatal + 28 days–12 months) and under-5 deaths per 1,000 live births; stillbirth rate per 1,000 total births. True MMR, IMR, TFR, child sex ratio (0–6), CPR, unmet need and stunting come from SRS and NFHS surveys and are not in HMIS; sex ratio shown is at birth (reported live births).
  • Coverage percentages use HMIS counts as denominators (e.g. early ANC = first-trimester registrations ÷ new ANC registrations). Blank values mean the item was not collected that year (ORS, zinc, newborn screening, adolescent items from 2023-24; SNCU admissions are reported differently from 2025-26).
  • 2026-27 covers April–October only, so counts are not comparable with full years; ratios are. District names changed in 2026-27 (14 districts).
